free_text: The patient is a 69-year-old male with a PSA of 7.0 and a prior biopsy grade of 3+3 (ISUP Grade Group 1). MRI showed a focal lesion (12 mm) with restricted diffusion but no extracapsular extension or seminal vesicle invasion. Given the low-grade disease and moderate LUTS (IPSS 15/35), the management assessment is active surveillance, balancing the risk of progression against the risks of intervention.
